issues.on_page: Budgetary Comparison Schedule - Cash Basis, Total Primary Government (pp12-13): revenue lines (Property Taxes 33,157; Federal Receipts 1,980,987; Pro-Rate Motor Vehicle 73; Highway Allocation and Incentive 37,419; Motor Vehicle Fees 2,474; Municipal Equalization 11,691; Other State Receipts 6,868; Motor Vehicle Taxes 2,480; In Lieu of Taxes 4,298; Other Local Receipts 584,932; Transfers 64,325) and disbursement lines (General Government 121,912; Public Works 85,738; Public Health and Social Services 13; Culture and Recreation 12,875; Sewer 2,577,536), with budgets
issues.issue: The extractor rules say a budget schedule's lines go into detail for every fund, including the business-type Sewer line. The extractor left the schedule out on purpose and explained why in notes: it is one all-funds column that mixes governmental and sewer revenue, so Federal and Other Local Receipts can't be given a fund_type, and its function lines include 64,325 of transfers. That reasoning holds up, but at least the Sewer disbursement line (actual 2,577,536, budget 2,674,767) could have been recorded as business-type. A person should decide.
